gate_exit_codes.simulation_method: Copy a min command-center tree the real CLIs accept, rewrite LF->CRLF in a sibling directory (core.autocrlf=true byte form), invoke python3 tools/command-center/validate.py and render.py --check

windows_prefix_raw_hash.method: sha256 of RAW CRLF working-tree bytes vs recorded LF digest; this is the pre-fix path (no .replace(b'\r\n', b'\n'))

negative_controls.description: Hash RAW CRLF working-tree bytes the way REACH-6 and render_manifest did before LF-normalise. Must disagree with recorded LF digests.
Delete the *.md eol=lf line from a copy of .gitattributes.

notes: G-1 for IMP-0441: named probes exit 0, receipt state=SUCCESS, per-unit manifest row. Did not run global unit_manifest.py --write. Did not destructively normalise the live tree. Linux CI workflow .github/workflows/command-center-eol.yml runs the same probes.
question_or_target: Add the EOL attributes that make the command-center gates runnable on the primary development box, then prove both gates exit zero on a Windows working tree. Exact target: the machine the program is authored on must be able to run its own gates.

residual_unknowns.claim: Dual-platform proof uses a min command-center tree the real CLIs accept (validate.py / render.py --check), not the live 103-item backlog. A live-tree red for a non-EOL reason is out of this unit's scope.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: On the authoring checkout, re-run python3 tools/command-center/validate.py and render.py --check under core.autocrlf=true.

residual_unknowns.claim: Gates were not executed on a Windows OS re-clone; CRLF materialisation matches the defect mechanism (working-tree bytes).
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: independent-claude-reviewer: git clone with core.autocrlf=true on Windows and run both gates.

retry.policy: max 2 attempts; escalate rather than normalizing line endings destructively across the tree

reviewer.notes: Independent of probe1: reproduces the pre-fix red hashes with a different method (raw sha256 vs CLI exit codes) and mutates .gitattributes. Not a clean Windows OS re-clone; CRLF materialisation of the working-tree bytes Git would emit under core.autocrlf=true.
